title: My dog refuses to eat after vaccination
content: My dog stopped eating after yesterday's vaccination. Is this normal or should I bring him to the vet immediately?

comments.content: Loss of appetite for 1–2 days can happen after vaccination. Monitor hydration and energy levels carefully.
If your dog starts vomiting, develops swelling, or refuses water, please visit a veterinary clinic immediately.
My dog had the same reaction before and recovered the next day.

title: How do I stop my cat from scratching furniture?
content: I bought a scratching post but my cat still scratches the sofa. Any advice?

comments.content: Try placing the scratching post near the sofa first.

title: Rabbit not eating hay
